focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚四国光伏产品加征反倾销税，出海企业需重估供应链布局
focus.summary: 美国商务部初步裁定，自柬埔寨、马来西亚、泰国和越南进口的光伏电池及组件存在倾销行为，拟加征反倾销税，税率因企业而异，最高或达70%以上。此举将直接影响中国光伏企业在东南亚的转口产能，并可能引发对规避关税的进一步调查。建议相关出海企业立即审查原产地规则、供应链溯源文件，并考虑多元化布局（如中东、拉美），同时评估美国海关针对规避行为的执法风险。
focus.title_en: US Preliminary Anti-Dumping Duties on Solar Imports from Four Southeast Asian Countries
focus.summary_en: The US Department of Commerce preliminarily determined that solar cells and modules from Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam were sold at less than fair value, proposing anti-dumping duties with rates up to over 70% for certain firms. This move directly impacts Chinese solar manufacturers' transshipment capacity in Southeast Asia and may trigger further circumvention investigations. Export-oriented companies should promptly review rules of origin, supply chain traceability documents, and consider diversifying production to the Middle East or Latin America, while assessing US Customs enforcement risks.
focus.source_en: Source: US Department of Commerce (DOC) announcement · 2026.08.04

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决获中国法院承认，跨境执行路径更清晰
case.summary: 近日，上海海事法院依据《纽约公约》承认并执行新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）一项涉及中英双方当事人的租船合同仲裁裁决。该案中，被申请人以仲裁庭未充分给予陈述机会为由抗辩，但法院认定仲裁程序符合当事人约定及新加坡法律，未违反中国公共政策，故裁定执行。此案提示出海企业，在约定SIAC等境外仲裁时，应确保程序合规，并注意中国法院对公共政策保留的适用尺度，以增强裁决可执行性。
case.title_en: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) Award Recognized by Chinese Court, Enhancing Cross-Border Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Shanghai Maritime Court recently recognized and enforced a SIAC arbitral award in a charter party dispute between Chinese and British parties, under the New York Convention. The respondent's defense that the tribunal failed to provide adequate opportunity to present its case was rejected, as the court found the procedure complied with party agreement and Singapore law, and did not violate Chinese public policy. This case highlights that Chinese enterprises opting for foreign arbitration venues like SIAC should ensure procedural compliance and be mindful of China's narrow public policy exception to improve enforceability.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境纠纷调解平台上线，为涉外企业提供高效解纷新通道
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅联合香港、澳门法律部门于8月1日正式上线“粤港澳大湾区跨境纠纷调解平台”，整合三地调解资源，提供线上申请、跨境视频调解、电子签署等服务，覆盖商事、金融、知识产权等领域。该平台首期对接三地共120名专业调解员，并建立调解协议互认与执行衔接机制。此举旨在降低跨境解纷成本，提升大湾区法治化营商环境，建议涉外企业将其纳入争议解决选项。
policy.title_en: Cross-Border Mediation Platform Launched in the Greater Bay Area, Offering New Efficient Dispute Resolution Channel
policy.summary_en: On August 1, the Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice, together with Hong Kong and Macao legal authorities, officially launched the 'Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Dispute Resolution Mediation Platform'. The platform integrates mediation resources from the three regions, providing online applications, cross-border video mediation, and e-signature services, covering commercial, financial, and IP disputes. It initially connects 120 professional mediators and establishes a mechanism for mutual recognition and enforcement of mediation agreements. This initiative aims to reduce cross-border dispute resolution costs and improve the business environment, and overseas-oriented enterprises are advised to consider this option.
policy.source_en: Source: Department of Justice of Guangdong Province · 2026.08.01

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟《外国补贴条例》调查常态化，中企应建立全流程合规档案
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟《外国补贴条例》（FSR）实施已逾一年，欧委会对涉及中国企业的调查呈常态化趋势，尤其集中在公共采购和并购领域。企业若在投标或交易前未充分评估外国补贴风险，可能面临高额罚款或失去投标资格。建议出海企业建立全流程合规档案，包括逐笔记录政府补贴、税收优惠、低息贷款等，并制定内部申报指引。同时，在交易文件中加入FSR风险分配条款，以应对可能的调查。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation Investigations Becoming Norm, Chinese Companies Should Establish Full-Chain Compliance Files
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: Over a year since the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation (FSR) took effect, the European Commission has shown a trend of regular investigations into Chinese companies, particularly in public procurement and M&A. Without adequate pre-bid or pre-transaction assessment of foreign subsidy risks, companies may face hefty fines or disqualification. It is advisable for overseas-oriented companies to establish comprehensive compliance files, including recording government subsidies, tax incentives, and low-interest loans, and to develop internal reporting guidelines. Additionally, include FSR risk allocation clauses in transaction documents to prepare for potential investigations.
